verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a driveItem search endpoint that matches items against a query across a folder hierarchy, a whole drive, or files shared with the user. That establishes a documented search API that goes beyond path lookup. However, the evidence never says the query covers full-text file content, as opposed to names and metadata. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that search indexes full-text file content, detail on query semantics beyond prefix matching, independent or hands-on corroboration.
